import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess

os.umask(0o022)
ROOT = Path("/home/eileenspectremoon/loa-dev/loa-aleph")
OUT = ROOT / "calibration/src-001/replay/preparation/PREP-SRC001-20260914-7ec21d2"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(OUT / "evidence").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode()

def sha(data):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def save(name, value):
    data = canonical(value)
    p = OUT / name
    with p.open("xb") as f:
        f.write(data)
    p.chmod(0o644)
    return {"path": str(p.relative_to(ROOT)), "byte_length": str(len(data)), "sha256": sha(data)}

commands = []
def run(args):
    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, timeout=45)
    result = {"argv": args, "exit": str(p.returncode), "stdout": p.stdout.decode(),
              "stderr": p.stderr.decode(), "stdout_sha256": sha(p.stdout),
              "stderr_sha256": sha(p.stderr), "started_at": start,
              "finished_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    commands.append(result)
    return result

tools = []
for name in ["qemu-system-x86_64", "qemu-img", "virsh", "virt-install",
             "cloud-hypervisor", "firecracker", "multipass", "limactl",
             "docker", "podman", "bwrap", "unshare", "strace", "node", "npm", "git"]:
    path = shutil.which(name)
    tools.append({"name": name, "path": path,
                  "realpath": str(Path(path).resolve()) if path else None,
                  "sha256": sha(Path(path).read_bytes()) if path else None})
paths = []
for name in ["/dev/kvm", "/run/libvirt/libvirt-sock", "/var/run/docker.sock",
             "/run/podman/podman.sock", "/var/lib/libvirt/images",
             "/home/eileenspectremoon/.local/share/libvirt/images",
             "/home/eileenspectremoon/.local/share/containers"]:
    p = Path(name)
    try:
        s = p.lstat()
        paths.append({"path": name, "present": True, "uid": str(s.st_uid),
                      "gid": str(s.st_gid), "mode": format(stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), "04o"),
                      "kind": "directory" if stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) else
                              "socket" if stat.S_ISSOCK(s.st_mode) else "other"})
    except FileNotFoundError:
        paths.append({"path": name, "present": False})
    except PermissionError:
        paths.append({"path": name, "observation": "PERMISSION_DENIED"})

for cmd in [["uname", "-srm"], ["id"], ["node", "--version"],
            ["npm", "--version"], ["git", "--version"], ["bwrap", "--version"],
            ["node", "node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc", "--version"],
            ["docker", "--host", "unix:///var/run/docker.sock", "info", "--format",
             "{{json .ServerVersion}} {{json .OSType}} {{json .Architecture}} {{json .SecurityOptions}}"],
            ["docker", "--host", "unix:///var/run/docker.sock", "image", "ls", "--no-trunc",
             "--digests", "--format", "{{json .}}"]]:

               {n for n in os.environ if n.startswith(("CODEX_", "CLAUDE_", "ANTHROPIC_", "AWS_", "OPENAI_"))})
for name in names:

    if name in ["PATH", "LANG", "LC_ALL", "TZ"]:
